A Hidden Gem at Hanoi Station: Must-Try Banh Mi by Mr. Duong
Sep 2025 • Solo
The banh mi at Hanoi Train Station is a must-try! Made by Mr. Duong, who is both friendly and skillful, the sandwich is packed with flavor. The bread is perfectly crispy, filled with fresh herbs, rich pate, Vietnamese cold cuts, and a delicious homemade sauce. It’s a simple yet satisfying bite that captures the essence of local street food. Every time I pass through the station, I make sure to grab one. Affordable, quick, and full of authentic taste — don’t miss Mr. Duong’s banh mi if you’re in Hanoi!

Best bm ever
Aug 2025
I’ve tried many banh mi spots around Hanoi, but the banh mi at the Hanoi Train Station by Mr. Duong really stands out. Not only do you get a hot, crispy baguette, but you can also taste the care and attention in every bite.

I ordered the pate banh mi, and I have to say, the pate was incredibly rich and flavorful, without being too greasy. The fillings were fresh, and the bread was perfectly crispy without being dry. The balance of flavors was just right, and every bite was a delight.

Mr. Duong is super friendly and always makes sure his customers are happy. The little stall is also clean and spacious, making it a great spot to grab a quick bite before your train ride.

If you’re at Hanoi Train Station, don’t miss the chance to try his banh mi – it’s definitely worth it!

Banh mi
Aug 2025
As a lifelong fan of Vietnamese street food, I can confidently say this bánh mì hits all the right notes. The bread is perfectly crisp on the outside, soft on the inside—exactly how it should be. The pickled carrots and daikon add a bright crunch, while the pâté and grilled pork are rich and flavorful. I especially appreciated the balance of sweet, salty, and spicy, with just the right amount of chili. It reminds me of the stalls back home in Saigon. If you're craving an authentic bite, this is it. Highly recommend!
—Duong

The banh mi at Gahnoi, made by Mr. Duong, is truly worth trying! If you are looking for a delicious, affordable banh mi, Gahnoi is a great choice!
